status: Source findings addressed; iPhone16 simulator keyboard check passed. Remaining native matrix open; not launch-ready.

findings.finding: The new layout-resizing KeyboardAvoidingView plus plain ScrollView does not ensure a low focused field is automatically revealed.
findings.required: Restore focus-aware scrolling without double keyboard compensation; verify lowest fields natively on small screens and large text.
findings.resolution: Restored KeyboardAwareScrollView mode=layout with one sticky footer, stable safe-area padding, measured focus clearance and negative extraKeyboardSpace matching the footer lift. No second KeyboardAvoidingView. iPhone16 numeric/text input and repeated upward scroll checked; small-screen, large-text and Android checks remain open.

findings.finding: POST success followed by refreshUser failure can strand an already-created request behind a misleading failure/retry.
findings.required: Treat POST success as commit boundary; route to pending despite best-effort refresh failure, with regression test.
findings.resolution: Successful shared-code POST is the commit boundary. Best-effort refresh failure no longer presents a failed join. New users route to request-pending; existing members route home to avoid trapping them in no-back onboarding. All four member/nonmember and refresh-success/failure combinations covered.

findings.finding: Disabled state is on a non-accessible wrapper rather than the native accessible control.
findings.required: Expose disabled state on the single accessible button and test VoiceOver behavior.
findings.resolution: Disabled/busy accessibility state moved onto the native Apple control and regression tested. Physical VoiceOver verification remains open.
